people.name: Władysław Bortnowski
people.nameZh: 瓦迪斯瓦夫·博爾特諾夫斯基

body.zh-Hant: 資料稱他1891年生於拉多姆，曾在亞捷隆大學學醫，其後在軍團第1旅服役，戰後畢業於巴黎軍事學院，並在波蘭軍隊擔任過多種現役與行政職務。皮烏蘇斯基研究院的名錄另稱他是波蘭軍團成員、第一旅軍官，也是1920年戰爭的老兵。
body.en: Sources say he was born in 1891 in Radom, studied medicine at the Jagiellonian University, then served in the 1st Brigade of the Legions, graduated from the Paris military academy after the war, and held various active and administrative posts in the Polish Army. The Piłsudski Institute's list adds that he was a Polish Legion member, a First Brigade officer and a veteran of the 1920 war.

body.zh-Hant: 切欣市議會於1938年12月2日開會，市長提出議案，建議授予博爾特諾夫斯基將軍切欣榮譽市民稱號，理由是他是佔領澤奧爾齊地區的西里西亞作戰集群的指揮者。市官網記載該提案獲一致通過。
body.en: Cieszyn's Town Council met on 2 December 1938, and the mayor proposed conferring honorary citizenship on General Bortnowski as the leader of the Śląsk Operational Group that occupied Zaolzie. The town's website records that the proposal was passed unanimously.

body.zh-Hant: 美國陸軍戰史列出波蘭的防禦部署：博爾特諾夫斯基少將統率一支由五個步兵師與一個騎兵旅組成的部隊（波莫瑞軍），負責防守走廊地帶。IPN 的九月戰役概述說，德軍第3、第4集團軍的裝甲部隊試圖切斷他的波莫瑞軍；該軍一部分雖有第9、第27步兵師的英勇防禦，仍在圖霍拉森林被包圍。
body.en: The US Army history lists the Polish dispositions: Maj. Gen. Bortnowski commanded a force of five infantry divisions and a cavalry brigade (Pomorze Army) that held the Corridor. The IPN survey of September 1939 says German armoured units of the 3rd and 4th Armies tried to cut off his Pomorze Army, and part of it was encircled in the Tuchola Forest despite the gallant defence of the 9th and 27th Infantry Divisions.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後流亡與皮烏蘇斯基研究院

body.zh-Hant: 皮烏蘇斯基研究院的名錄稱，博爾特諾夫斯基被德軍俘虜，戰後前往倫敦，是倫敦皮烏蘇斯基研究院的創辦人與首任院長，並自1954年起住在美國。同一名錄把他列為1961至1962年的美國皮烏蘇斯基研究院院長。
body.en: The Piłsudski Institute's list says Bortnowski was taken prisoner by the Germans, went to London after the war, founded and first presided over the Piłsudski Institute in London, and lived in the USA from 1954. The same list shows him as president of the Piłsudski Institute of America in 1961–1962.
